QUOTE: `ServerDataOperatorBase` itself extends `BaseDataOperator` (`app/database/operator/base_data_operator/index.ts:33`), which holds the `database` handle and the generic machinery: `processRecords`, `prepareRecords`, `handleRecords`, `batchRecords`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says every handler write funnels through `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`, but it never says each mixin is constrained to extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`. That constraint is the mechanism the item requires.
